name: Sticky Bunny
summary: Raise a persistent rabbit, focus with Pomodoro, share your status, and ask the Book of Answers.
description: Sticky Bunny turns reTerminal Sticky into a living virtual pet and an offline ePaper app collection. Raise a rabbit that grows through five stages and develops its own personality, run Pomodoro sessions, show a full-screen status, or shake the device to ask the Book of Answers. Touch, side buttons, swipe gestures, rotation, RTC scheduling, battery display, and deep sleep are integrated into one firmware experience.

compatibility.notes: Version 0.1.1 uses the release profile tested on reTerminal Sticky production hardware and includes the verified GT911 touch recovery update.

assets.previewAlt: Sticky Bunny app launcher running on reTerminal Sticky

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB-C data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Clean installation
notes.description: When moving from another firmware, accept the erase prompt to start with a fresh pet save and the first-boot guide.

notes.title: First boot
notes.description: Follow the six illustrated pages, hatch the egg with three deliberate taps, and name the new pet on the device.

notes.title: App launcher
notes.description: Tap the AI key or swipe up to open the launcher. Choose by touch, rotate for Pomodoro or Status Board, shake for the Book of Answers, and double-tap the AI key to return to the pet.
